questions.stem: A 60-year-old male patient comes to OPD with lipodystrophy. On taking drug history, he said that he is taking drugs for his HIV infection and the drugs are zidovudine, lamivudine, and lopinavir/Ritonavir. Which of the following drug is used in the treatment of his lipodystrophy?
questions.solutionHtml:
Tesamorelin

Tesamorelin is used for the treatment of HIV-associated lipodystrophy.



Harrison’s Principles & Practice of Medicine, 21st edition, page no. 3119.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hypothalamus And Pituitary Hormones Pharmacology
questions.stem: A 60-year-old male patient comes to OPD with low back pain and difficulty during micturition. His PSA levels are 100 ng/ml. which of the following drug is used in treatment?
questions.solutionHtml:
Goserelin
  • Male patient with low back pain and difficulty during micturition.
  • His PSA levels are 100 ng/ml, the case history points towards prostate cancer. The drug used for treatment is GnRH agonists like Goserelin by continuous administration.
  • Continuous administration of GnRH agonists down-regulates GnRH receptors in the pituitary gland.
  • This suppresses the release of the gonadotropins -FSH and LH from the
  • During the transient rise in LH, the resultant testosterone surge may induce acute stimulation of prostate cancer growth and a “flare” of symptoms from metastatic deposits.
  • Patients may experience an increase in bone pain, spinal cord compression, or obstructive bladder symptoms lasting for 2–3 weeks.
  • The flare phenomenon can be effectively counteracted with concurrent administration of 2–4 weeks of oral antiandrogen therapy, which may inhibit the action of the increased serum testosterone levels.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 263,264.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hypothalamus And Pituitary Hormones Pharmacology
questions.stem: A female was given a higher dose of methyl ergometrine for postpartum hemorrhage and continued after that for several days. Mother had very little milk secretion for 1 month. The reason for this is-

options.label: A
options.text: Partial agonistic action of methyl ergometrine on 5-ht2 receptors

options.label: B
options.text: Partial agonistic action of methyl ergometrine on ? adrenergic receptors

options.label: C
options.text: Agonistic action of methyl ergometrine on dopamine receptors

questions.answerText: Agonistic action of methyl ergometrine on dopamine receptors
questions.solutionHtml:
Agonistic action of methyl ergometrine on dopamine receptors
  • As dopamine is a Prolactin release inhibitor.
  • The dopamine agonist action of methyl ergometrine when used in higher doses  is responsible for little milk secretion in the mother.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:357.

questions.stem: Which of the following GnRH Agonists can be given by nasal spray?
questions.solutionHtml:
Nafarelin
  • Nafarelin is a long-acting GnRH agonist that is 150 times more potent than native GnRH.
  • It is used as an intranasal spray from which bioavailability is only 4–5%.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the drug of choice for precocious puberty?
questions.solutionHtml:
GnRH analog

GnRH analogs- are DOC for precocious puberty. but they need to be given continuously to suppress the release of FSH, and LH and thereby decrease estrogen and progesterone in females and testosterone in males.
